scripts.build: vite build --config frontend/diff/vite.config.mjs && tailwindcss -i crates/preview/src/styles/preview.css -o crates/preview/src/embedded/generated/preview.css --minify && tailwindcss -i crates/desktop/src/render/viewer.css -o crates/desktop/src/embedded/generated/viewer.css --minify && cp frontend/inline/theme-boot.ts crates/preview/src/embedded/generated/boot.js && cp frontend/inline/theme-control.ts crates/desktop/src/embedded/generated/theme-control.js && cp frontend/inline/pending-recipes.ts crates/desktop/src/embedded/generated/pending-recipes.js
scripts.fix: oxlint frontend/diff frontend/core frontend/inline --fix && oxfmt frontend/diff frontend/core .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.mjs
scripts.format: oxfmt frontend/diff frontend/core .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check frontend/diff frontend/core .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.mjs
